prompt:

Image 2 is ONLY the approved illustration style reference; do not copy its milk product or packaging. Preserve the exact packaging type, proportions, recognizable brand, colors, layout and main readable label words from the source photo; don't invent ingredients, quantities, claims or change product. NO photorealism, 3D rendering, isometric perspective, hands, shelves, props, exterior shadows, floor, glow, white/cream background or drawn checkerboard. Background must be actual alpha transparency. Ensure even the transparent plastic, white/metallic packaging and thin edges remain part of the product; transparency applies outside the silhouette.

Specific subject: Spray bucal refrescante Deliplus (Mercadona 52464).
